scope: Targeted sustain/ammunition/Fever audit of current public Skill API; 24 complete native method bodies and 25 installed component projections. No runtime/XLua observation or production changes.

native.feverExistingActivation: FeverBehaviour._JoinFeverDuringSkill writes m_isJoinDuringSkill=true. _LeaveFever forwards the saved bool to OnBeforeLeaveFever; true skips the branch that interrupts the Skill.
native.feverDuration: FeverCommonBehaviour.OnAfterJoinFever calls Ability.get_cooldown, adds get_feverTime, and calls virtual UpdateCooldown(period, waitFirst=false, keepPassedTime=true) when _updateAbilityCooldown is set. The actual Mortis S1/S2 behaviours enable it.
native.feverTimeSource: get_feverTime reads FeverSystemManager.data +0x18. This is the configured Fever period, not proven to be an arbitrary per-instance remaining duration.
native.feverNewActivation: OnBeforeLeaveFever for a non-preexisting activation interrupts/switches out, and configured _updateCoolDownIfInterrupt restores the original SkillData.duration after interruption.
native.feverSp: OnBeforeJoinFever samples SP; _RecoverSpCost/_RevertRecoverSpCost provide temporary SP bookkeeping. These are native implementation details, not a requirement to emulate artificial SP grants in Content.
native.tuye: The installed skchr_tuye_2 root is CastSkillWithLimitTimes with _canDiscardRemainingCount=false. Its Ability hierarchy includes an independent event counter. Existing Case09 and PRTS establish 3-ammo exhaustion and a different native duration classification from ordinary AMMO.
native.manualClose: Melantha uses skill skcom_atk_up[1], whose separately-versioned table selects installed prefab skcom_atk_up. Its root is ordinary CastSkill, which has no IsDiscardable or isRetriggerable override. Ordinary native BasicSkill.IsDiscardable #73803 and isRetriggerable #73801 return false. Tuye CastSkillWithLimitTimes.IsDiscardable additionally requires its configured _canDiscardRemainingCount, which is false in Tuye S2.

coreAssessment.mapping: Existing extendTime can preserve the remaining ordinary Skill interval across the known fixed Fever window. Entry/exit bookkeeping belongs to the concrete Fever manager. No evidence here requires replacing TIME.endsAtTick or adding a universal pause state.

coreAssessment.topic: Fever starts while under ordinary SP threshold
coreAssessment.mapping: activation.cost can make payment zero but activate still checks Definition.sp.requirement; existing API cannot naturally vary the launch requirement for Fever. Group under runtime SP configuration/activation policy rather than a new Fever subsystem.

Tuye proves resource identity differs from native duration identity, but still finishes only on ammunition exhaustion. Existing AMMO budget can represent this. This audit does not establish a finite TIME plus AMMO dual-exit Core requirement.

Ammo possession, consume/replenish/grant notifications, and ordinary-AMMO bonus eligibility are separate. Tuye can use AMMO budget but must be excluded from bonuses requiring native AMMO duration. Contribution Input can filter by shared static Definition identity/qualification; do not infer every bonus solely from sustain.type.

Capacity is sampled at launch; ordinary replenish has a per-activation cumulative ceiling; grant excludes its own additions from this ceiling and still respects capacity. Confirmed Inside/Lemuen changes affect later launch samples. No actual mid-activation base-counter replacement example found.

Existing onOperation plus operationRestrictions can express Uyou close, Horn conditional dump and retrigger denial without a new lifecycle protocol. Generic STOP defaults to finish, so Content must explicitly deny unsupported player operations; this default is a project policy to audit, not evidence every native Skill is closable.

extendTime permits negative adjustment and normal deadline checks settle later; the selected Fever original-budget reset follows interruption. No confirmed actual caller here requires a new immediate-duration-shortening Core operation.

coreAssessment.topic: Existing unsupported STOP operation is accepted
coreAssessment.mapping: Melantha Content provides neither onOperation nor operationRestrictions. Public Skill.operate defaults STOP to finish and the command layer forwards STOP, so a normal timed attack-up can be actively ended. Existing onOperation/restriction APIs can express correct qualification; choice of default or Content registration remains an architecture decision, not a new lifecycle requirement.

limitations: No blanket statement that every native sustain mechanism is covered.
No finite TIME plus ammo positive configuration was established; absence in this targeted audit does not prove global absence.
No active XLua or runtime experiment.
Skill start/exit animation policy and special action cancellation remain outside this bounded audit.

communitySources.paraphrase: Fever can trigger member Skills without the normal SP threshold/payment, preserves an already-active timed Skill across the Fever window, and ends Skills newly started through Fever when Fever ends.
S2 has three rounds, ends on ammo exhaustion, can interact with ammo consumption and replenishment, but is excluded from most bonuses that specifically require the native AMMO duration category.
S3 gains extra ammo independently of the ordinary replenishment quota; the current ammo amount still cannot exceed capacity.
S2 self-granted ammo is independent of the ordinary replenishment quota; capacity bonus is sampled when the Skill begins.
